facts.statement: The only known species, Tratayenia rosalesi, was described in March 2018 based on a partial skeleton.
facts.quote: The genus contains a single species, Tratayenia rosalesi, known from a partial skeleton described in March 2018.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen is cataloged as MUCPv 1162 and consists of a well-preserved partial skeleton with articulated backbone sections.
facts.quote: The holotype consists of a well-preserved partial skeleton, MUCPv 1162, which includes several articulated portions of the backbone.

facts.statement: The skeleton was first discovered in 2006 at the Bajo de la Carpa Formation site by technician Diego Rosales.
facts.quote: This skeleton was first discovered in 2006 at a Bajo de la Carpa Formation fossil site by Universidad Nacional del Comahue technician Diego Rosales.

facts.statement: The species name rosalesi honors the discoverer, Diego Rosales.
facts.quote: The specific name Tratayenia rosalesi honors Diego Rosales.

facts.statement: The genus name Tratayenia was chosen in 2018 after the fossil site of Tratayén where it was excavated.
facts.quote: In 2018, the new taxon was described with the generic name Tratayenia, named after Tratayén, the fossil site at which it was excavated.

facts.statement: Tratayenia is an extinct megaraptoran theropod from the Santonian age of the Late Cretaceous found in Argentina.
facts.quote: Tratayenia is an extinct genus of megaraptoran theropod dinosaur known from the Late Cretaceous (Santonian age) Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Argentina.

facts.statement: Tratayenia lived approximately 83 million years ago, making it one of the youngest known megaraptoran genera.
facts.quote: Tratayenia is one of the youngest known genera of megaraptorans, having lived only about 83 million years ago.

facts.statement: Tratayenia was a medium-sized megaraptoran that grew up to 8 meters long.
facts.quote: Tratayenia was a medium-sized megaraptoran, growing up to 8 m long.

facts.statement: Tratayenia likely possessed large hand claws used for hunting prey, a trait common among megaraptorans.
facts.quote: Like most other megaraptorans, it probably had large claws on its hands for use in hunting prey.

facts.statement: Tratayenia has a unique adaptation where the front vertebral joint plates are rectangular with edges converging at nearly a right angle.
facts.quote: The prezygapophyses (front vertebral joint plates) are rectangular when see from the side, with the front and lower edges converging at nearly a right angle. This is an autapomorphy (unique adaptation) of Tratayenia.

facts.statement: A unique feature of Tratayenia is that the prezygodiapophyseal lamina runs parallel to the paradiapophyseal lamina.
facts.quote: Another autapomorphy of Tratayenia is that the prezygodiapophyseal lamina is parallel to the paradiapophyseal lamina.

facts.statement: Tratayenia possesses a unique feature involving two pairs of laminae connecting the front vertebral joints to the neural spines.
facts.quote: The front edge of each vertebra has a third autapomorphy, related to two pairs of laminae (four total) connecting the prezygapophyses to the neural spines.

facts.statement: Tratayenia has five sacral vertebrae, which is the standard number for theropods.
facts.quote: Tratayenia has five sacral (hip) vertebrae, as is the norm for theropods.

facts.statement: The upper blade of the hip in Tratayenia was heavily pneumatized, meaning it contained air pockets.
facts.quote: The ilium (upper blade of the hip) was heavily pneumatized, meaning that it was filled with air pockets.

facts.statement: Tratayenia lived in a semi-arid environment characterized by river and wind-blown sediment systems.
facts.quote: Its sediments represent fluvial and aeolian systems, with a semi-arid paleoenvironment.

facts.statement: The same formation as Tratayenia contains fossils of other theropods like Rinconraptor, abelisauroids, alvarezsaurids, and early birds.
facts.quote: In addition to Tratayenia, several dinosaurs are known from this formation. Theropods include the fellow megaraptorid Rinconraptor, abelisauroids (Velocisaurus, Llukalkan, and Viavenator), alvarezsaurids (Achillesaurus and Alvarezsaurus), the unenlagiine paravian Diuqin, and the avialans (birds, in the broad sense) Neuquenornis and Patagopteryx.

facts.statement: Tratayenia shared its habitat with the ornithopod Mahuidacursor and various titanosaurian sauropods.
facts.quote: Other dinosaurs include the elasmarian ornithopod Mahuidacursor and diverse titanosaurian sauropods, such as Bonitasaura, Inawentu, Overosaurus, Rinconsaurus, Traukutitan, and Yeneen.

facts.statement: In 2018, researchers Porfiri et al. classified Tratayenia within a large unresolved group of megaraptorids.
facts.quote: Porfiri et al. (2018) preferred this third hypothesis. Their analysis, which expanded on that of Apesteguia et al. (2016), recovered all megaraptorids, including Tratayenia, in a large unresolved polytomy.

facts.statement: The evolutionary relationships of megaraptorans, including Tratayenia, to other theropods remain highly controversial.
facts.quote: Megaraptorans have very controversial relations to other theropods.

facts.statement: One hypothesis suggests megaraptorans are carnosaurs distantly related to Allosaurus and closely related to Neovenator and carcharodontosaurids.
facts.quote: The first mainstream hypothesis is that they are carnosaurs, distantly related to Allosaurus and more closely related to Neovenator and carcharodontosaurids.

facts.statement: Another hypothesis proposes that megaraptorans are basal tyrannosauroids within the coelurosaur lineage.
facts.quote: The second popular hypothesis considers them to be basal tyrannosauroids, part of the coelurosaur lineage which includes the crested proceratosaurids as well as the famous tyrannosaurids such as Tyrannosaurus.

facts.statement: A third hypothesis places megaraptorans as coelurosaurs outside Tyrannosauroidea and basal to most other coelurosaur groups.
facts.quote: A third hypothesis also considers them to be coelurosaurs, but outside Tyrannosauroidea and basal to practically all other groups of Coelurosauria.

facts.statement: Tratayenia lived alongside lizards, turtles, snakes, birds, crocodylomorphs, and dinosaurs such as Viavenator and Traukutitan in the Bajo de la Carpa Formation.
facts.quote: Tratayenia vivió en la Formación Bajo de la Carpa junto a muchas lagartijas y tortugas, la especie de serpiente Dinilysia patagonica, muchas aves como Patagopteryx deferrariisi , una diversa cantidad de crocodilomorfos y muchos dinosaurios como Viavenator exxoni y Traukutitan eocaudata.

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton was first discovered in 2006 by technician Diego Rosales at a fossil site in the Bajo de la Carpa Formation.
facts.quote: Este esqueleto fue descubierto por primera vez en 2006 en un sitio fósil de la Formación Bajo de la Carpa por el técnico de la Universidad Nacional del Comahue, Diego Rosales.

facts.statement: In a 2008 preliminary report, Porfiri and colleagues suggested the dinosaur might be a relative of Carcharodontosauridae.
facts.quote: Porfiri y sus colegas publicaron un informe preliminar sobre el nuevo dinosaurio en un resumen de 2008 y sugirieron que podría haber sido un pariente de Carcharodontosauridae.

facts.statement: The genus was formally described in March 2018 and named after the fossil site of Tratayén where it was excavated.
facts.quote: En marzo de 2018, el nuevo taxón se describió con el nombre genérico Tratayenia, llamado así por Tratayén, el sitio fósil en el que se excavó.

facts.statement: The species name rosalesi honors the discoverer Diego Rosales.
facts.quote: El nombre específico Tratayenia rosalesi honra a Diego Rosales.

facts.statement: Tratayenia was a medium-sized megaraptoran with an estimated length of about 8 meters.
facts.quote: Tratayenia era un megaraptorano de tamaño mediano, con una longitud estimada en unos 8 metros.

facts.statement: Like other group members, Tratayenia likely possessed large hand claws used for hunting prey.
facts.quote: Como muchos otros miembros del grupo, Tratayenia probablemente tenía grandes garras en sus manos que se usarían para cazar a sus presas.

facts.statement: Tratayenia is the largest carnivore found in the Bajo de la Carpa Formation, supporting the hypothesis that megaraptorids were apex predators in South America from the Turonian to the Santonian or early Campanian.
facts.quote: Tratayenia es asimismo el animal carnívoro de mayor tamaño descubierto en esta formación geológica, reforzando la hipótesis de que los megaraptóridos fueron los superdepredadores en el Cono Sur en las épocas del Turoniense hasta el Santoniense o inicios del Campaniense, siguiendo a la extinción de los carcarodontosáuridos.

facts.statement: The rectangular shape of the precoracoid processes with converging front and lower borders is a unique adaptation of Tratayenia.
facts.quote: Esta es una adaptación única de Tratayenia.

facts.statement: A unique feature of Tratayenia is that the prezygodiapophyseal lamina is parallel to the paradiapophyseal lamina.
facts.quote: Otra autapomorfía de Tratayenia es que la lámina prezigodiapofisaria es paralela a la lámina paradiapofisaria.

facts.statement: A third unique feature of Tratayenia involves two pairs of laminae connecting the prezygapophyses to the neural spines.
facts.quote: El borde frontal de cada vértebra tiene una tercera autapomorfía, relacionada con dos pares de láminas, cuatro en total, que conectan las prezigapófisis con las espinas neurales.

facts.statement: Tratayenia had five sacral vertebrae, which is standard for theropods.
facts.quote: Tratayenia tiene cinco vértebras sacras, como es la norma para los terópodos.

facts.statement: The neural spine of the fifth sacral vertebra is twice as long anteroposteriorly as that of the first.
facts.quote: De hecho, la espina neural del quinto sacro es dos veces más larga anteroposteriormente que la del primero.

facts.statement: The ilium was highly pneumatized, meaning it was filled with air sacs.
facts.quote: El ilion, hueso superior de la cadera, estaba muy neumatizado, lo que significa que estaba lleno de bolsas de aire.

facts.statement: The description of Tratayenia by Porfiri et al. supports the hypothesis that megaraptorans are coelurosaurs outside of Tyrannosauroidea.
facts.quote: La descripción realizada por Porfiri et al. de Tratayenia sustenta la tercera hipótesis.

facts.statement: Determining the evolutionary relationships of megaraptorans has been a subject of controversy.
facts.quote: Determinar las relaciones evolutivas de los megaraptoranos ha sido materia de controversia.

facts.statement: One widely accepted hypothesis suggests megaraptorans are carnosaurs distantly related to Allosaurus and more closely related to Neovenator and carcharodontosaurids.
facts.quote: La primera hipótesis ampliamente aceptada es que son carnosaurios, emparentados distantemente con Allosaurus y más cercanamente a Neovenator y los carcarodontosáuridos.

facts.statement: A popular hypothesis postulates that megaraptorans are tyrannosauroids, part of the coelurosaur lineage that includes crested proceratosaurids and famous tyrannosaurids like Tyrannosaurus.
facts.quote: La segunda hipótesis más popular postula que son tiranosauroideos, parte del linaje de los celurosaurios que incluye a los proceratosáuridos crestados así como a los famosos tiranosáuridos tales como Tyrannosaurus.

facts.statement: Tratayenia rosalesi lived during the Late Cretaceous, between 86 and 83 million years ago in the Santonian stage, in what is now South America.
facts.quote: Tratayenia rosalesi es la única especie conocida del género extinto Tratayenia de dinosaurio terópodo megaraptorano, que vivió a fianales del período Cretácico, entre 86 y 83 millones de años, durante el Santoniense, en lo que es hoy Sudamérica.

facts.statement: The skeleton was excavated shortly after discovery by paleontologist Juan D. Porfiri.
facts.quote: Poco después fue excavado por el paleontólogo de esta Juan D. Porfifi.

facts.statement: The neural arches of the vertebrae are taller and narrower in Tratayenia than in most other theropods.
facts.quote: Los arcos neurales de las vértebras son más altos y estrechos en Tratayenia que en la mayoría de los otros terópodos.

facts.statement: Ilium pneumatization is more common in megaraptorans than in other theropods, as seen in taxa like Aerosteon and Murusraptor.
facts.quote: La neumatización del ilion es más común en megaraptoranos que entre los otros terópodos, como se ve en taxones como Aerosteon y Murusraptor.

facts.statement: The evolutionary classification of Tratayenia follows a strict consensus derived from the average of the 12 most parsimonious evolutionary trees.
facts.quote: El cladograma mostrado a continuación sigue el consenso estricto, resultado promedio, de los 12 árboles evolutivos más parsimoniosos

facts.quote: Parent group: Megaraptoridae

facts.statement: Tratayenia is classified within the family Megaraptoridae.
facts.quote: Family: Megaraptoridae

facts.statement: Tratayenia is classified as a reptile.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia

facts.statement: Tratayenia lived during the Santonian stage, between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Santonian to Santonian (85.7 to 83.6 million years ago)

facts.quote: Fossil occurrences recorded: 1
